Finding.Statement: The hardened M03 engine deterministically auto-selects WI-07-0.2.4 and returns CLEAR whenever it is run against the current authoritative trial workbook: M-07-0.2 is the current-work anchor (freshest open reservation CHG-20260830-017, row 80) and WI-07-0.2.4 is its only dependency-satisfied planned child. Because trial M10 is NOT_APPLICABLE by design, the previous trial reservation cannot be closed, so WI-07-0.2.4 remains perpetually 'next'. The operator explicitly prohibits WI-07-0.2.4 as the new task. There is no governed path for the engine to select a different (fresh) work item while this reservation state stands.
